definition: The audience learns the problem exists and what could fix it.
informed_by: Informed by CEI ASF (awareness) and HFRP CLM interim outcomes; HCF wording

definition: The audience sees it as important and wants to act.
informed_by: Informed by CEI ASF (will); HCF wording

definition: More of the public wants the change.
More decision-makers are willing to act.
People start to see the issue in a new way.
example: Sleep framed as a school-schedule problem, not teen laziness.

definition: The audience does something: votes, signs, joins, decides.
informed_by: Informed by CEI ASF (action); HCF wording

definition: Respected people start speaking for the policy.
The policy is adopted, blocked, funded or enforced.
Advocates themselves get stronger: skills, partners, money, visibility.
informed_by: Informed by HFRP CLM capacity outcomes; HCF wording
